Vendored from the user's local working copy of a fork of Allison Parrish's
"phonetic-similarity-vectors" (https://github.com/aparrish/phonetic-similarity-vectors).

Source path : E:\Project\Work in Progress\phonetic-similarity-vectors-master
Fork remote : https://github.com/TonyYZ/Workin-Progress.git
Fork commit : 58f5639  ("Initial commit")

Files copied (code + feature tables only; the multi-GB *Emb.txt / *V.txt data
that lived alongside them upstream is NOT vendored and is regenerated by the
pipeline):
  generate.py         IPA -> feature-bigram counts -> PCA(whiten, n=300) -> word vectors
  generateTable.py    builds a consonant x vowel syllable table (wordTable.csv)
  similarity.py       interactive nearest-neighbour lookup over an embedding file
  featurephone.py     phone -> articulatory-feature set; feature_bigrams()
  ipa2feature.csv     IPA segment -> space-separated feature codes (read by featurephone.py)
  features.xlsx       reference feature inventory
  features2.xlsx      reference feature inventory (variant)
  LICENSE, README.md  upstream project license and readme

Local modifications already present in this fork (kept as-is):
  - generate.py prints a leading "<count> <dim>" line so the output parses as
    word2vec text format ("only for Nguasach project!!").
  - similarity.py skips that header line (i == 0) and hardcodes AnnoyIndex(50).
  - featurephone.py reads ipa2feature.csv instead of the hardcoded CMUdict map,
    and handles the ʰ / ʲ / ̃ / ᵝ diacritics as extra features (asp/pzd/nzd/cmp).

Runtime note: generate.py and featurephone.py open 'ipa2feature.csv' /
'wordTable.csv' by relative path, so they must be executed with this directory
as the working directory. src/nguasach/phonetics.py handles that.
